lead: `$m as ?string` on a `mixed` that is `null` gives `""`, not `null`, while `as ?int`, `as ?float` and `as ?array<T>` give `null`.
body: `rule:types/conversion` makes `anything → string` total, and `a-nullable-conversion-to-string-answers-null-where-the-checked-one-throws.nvst` pins the empty string, so `Core\Session::get("user") as ?string` followed by `== null` takes the wrong branch and the example prints a blank name. Test the `mixed` for `null` first and convert after, as `docs/examples/core/Session/start/03-a-page-for-signed-in-users.nvs` does.
